mapper.select: select r.role_id id, r.name, r.code from b_user u, b_role r, r_user_role ur where u.flag = 1 and r.flag = 1 and ur.flag = 1 and u.user_id = ur.user_id and r.role_id = ur.role_id and u.tenant_id = r.tenant_id and u.user_id = #{userId}

select b.`name` AS username, b.realname, b.open_id, a.user_id, b.mobile from r_user_role a LEFT JOIN b_user b ON b.user_id = a.user_id LEFT JOIN r_user_tenant c ON c.user_id = b.user_id where b.flag = 1 and a.role_id = #{roleId} AND c.organization_id = #{organizationId}
select b.`name` AS username, b.realname, b.open_id, a.user_id from r_user_role a LEFT JOIN b_user b ON b.user_id = a.user_id where b.flag = 1 and a.role_id = #{roleId}

select a.open_id, a.user_id, a.`name`, a.mobile, a.remark, a.realname, a.address, a.company from b_user a LEFT JOIN r_user_tenant b ON b.user_id = a.user_id where a.flag != -1 AND b.organization_id = #{orgId}
SELECT bo.app_id as appid FROM b_openid_share bos LEFT JOIN b_openid bo ON share_openid_id = bo.openid_id WHERE bos.flag = 1 AND bo.flag = 1 AND bos.user_id = #{uid}

select count(u.user_id) from b_user u, b_role r, r_user_role ur where u.flag = 1 and r.flag = 1 and ur.flag = 1 and u.user_id = ur.user_id and r.role_id = ur.role_id and u.tenant_id = r.tenant_id and r.code = 'applet_user' and u.create_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime}

select count(u.user_id) AS new_user_count from b_user u, b_role r, r_user_role ur where u.flag = 1 and r.flag = 1 and ur.flag = 1 and u.user_id = ur.user_id and r.role_id = ur.role_id and u.tenant_id = r.tenant_id and r.code = 'applet_user' and u.create_time between #{startTime} and #{endTime}

select a.mobile from b_user a join r_user_tenant b on b.flag = 1 and b.user_id = a.user_id join b_organization c on c.flag = 1 and c.organization_id = b.organization_id join r_user_role d on d.flag = 1 and d.user_id = a.user_id join b_role e on e.flag = 1 and e.role_id = d.role_id where a.flag = 1 /*集团总部*/ and c.parent_organization_id is null /*集团客服*/ and e.code = 'jt_customer' and a.tenant_id = #{tenantId}

select bu.`name` as username, bu.realname, bu.open_id, bu.user_id, bu.mobile from b_user bu join r_user_role rur on rur.flag = 1 and rur.user_id = bu.user_id join b_role br on br.flag = 1 and br.role_id = rur.role_id join r_user_tenant rut on rut.flag = 1 and rut.user_id = bu.user_id join b_organization bo on bo.flag = 1 and bo.organization_id = rut.organization_id where bu.flag = 1 and bu.status = 0 and bu.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and br.code = #{roleCode} and bo.organization_id = #{organizationId}

select b.user_id, b.name, b.remark, b.open_id from b_user b JOIN wf_form wf ON wf.create_user_id = b.user_id JOIN sc_service_contract sc ON sc.form_id = wf.form_id where sc.service_contract_id = #{scid} limit 1
